Another angle: the theft happened September 25; the SlowMist tweet is about investigation progress. This is a CEX security incident not touching the venue (intents.near) or the bridge (HOT Omni). Per instructions: "do not react to noise or to incidents that do not touch this position."

Could the Bitget incident indirectly matter? Bitget is a major exchange; a hot wallet theft of ~$X could cause some market jitters, but USDT itself isn't implicated. The bridged BSC-USDT backing is on-chain and verified matching. No pause, no depeg signal, no bridge anomaly.

So risk: low, action: hold.

Decision: risk low, action hold. Reasons: backing fully intact per onchain monitor; Bitget hot wallet theft is a CEX incident not connected to intents.near venue or HOT Omni bridge; no pause/anomaly observed.
